# ALLWIN AIR (올윈에어)

> ALLWIN AIR is a South Korean B2B Ancillary Gateway System (AGS). It connects the paid ancillary services of multiple Korean airlines to travel agencies, OTAs and partner platforms through a single integration, and handles airline integration maintenance, customer service and settlement. It does not sell directly to consumers.
> 올윈에어는 여러 항공사의 부가서비스를 여행사·OTA에 단일 연동으로 제공하고 유지보수·CS·정산까지 대행하는 대한민국의 B2B 항공 부가서비스 통합 연동 플랫폼입니다.

Contact for partnerships: partnership@allwin.co.kr / +82 1522-2284 (Korea, weekdays 09:00-18:00 KST). English and Japanese inquiries welcome (日本語でのお問い合わせ歓迎); e-mail recommended from overseas.
Address: 901, 9F Central Park Tower, 17 Seobinggo-ro, Yongsan-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea.

## What we offer
- Live ancillaries: seat selection with AI seat recommendation, pre-paid extra baggage, in-flight meals, priority baggage (fast baggage claim), golf package
- In development: Block Seat (before departure, passengers buy the unsold empty seats next to their own seat so they can spread out or lie down across the row), SIM/eSIM, home-airport pickup, airport duty-free, airport facility services
- Paused: airport lounge, in-flight duty-free
- AI seat recommendation: recommends seats for the whole party from booking (PNR) context instead of a plain seat map, so seat selection is simple and fast
- Sales models: bundled purchase with the ticket, post-payment offer, my-page purchase after ticketing

## Why partners use ALLWIN AIR
- Travel agencies/OTAs: one integration for many airlines, new ancillary revenue, ALLWIN AIR handles maintenance, CS and settlement
- Airlines: sell ancillaries through the travel agency channel without integrating each agency
- Global/inbound partners: a single Korean point of contact for Korean airline ancillaries; distribution for services targeting travelers to Korea

- Airlines (live): Jin Air (진에어), Jeju Air (제주항공), Trinity Airways (트리니티항공, formerly T'way Air / 구 티웨이항공), Air Busan (에어부산), Air Seoul (에어서울), Air Premia (에어프레미아), Eastar Jet (이스타항공)

## Looking for
Foreign OTAs and travel platforms selling Korean airline tickets; foreign airlines serving Korea; eSIM, airport transfer/pickup, airport duty-free, lounge, fast track and other travel ancillary suppliers; inbound travel businesses serving visitors to Korea.

## Business model (사업모델 소개 / ビジネスモデル)
- Position: GDS distributes airline tickets; ALLWIN AIR's AGS (Ancillary Gateway System) distributes ancillaries between suppliers (airlines, ancillary providers) and sellers (travel agencies, OTAs, platforms). Agencies sell about 70-90% of airline tickets, but until 2019 could not sell ancillaries.
- One connection: partners integrate once; ALLWIN AIR handles airline/NDC API integration, standard conversion, display control, purchase screens, unified payment, customer service, settlement and maintenance. Estimated integration resources: about 1/8 for an agency and 1/20 for an airline versus direct integrations (2021 estimate, 8 airlines x 20 agencies).
- Revenue model: suppliers gain the agency channel and extra revenue; sellers gain a new revenue stream from ancillary sales commission on top of ticket incentives; travelers buy ancillaries where they booked (up to about 30% cheaper than at the airport). Commission terms are set per partner agreement.
- Sales flows: my-page purchase (Interpark international, Nov 2019), bundled purchase with the ticket (Interpark international, Oct 2020), post-payment purchase (Webtour domestic, Nov 2020). Early purchase conversion (items / visitors): 56.1% international (Nov 2019-Apr 2021), 25.2% domestic (Nov 2020-Apr 2021), vs 1-2% typical e-commerce.
- AI seat recommendation: PNR-based, party-level seat recommendation (with a child, couple, group) instead of a plain seat map; patents filed for seat pre-purchase (10-2021-0035677) and item recommendation (10-2020-0069932); seat-upgrade auction/pricing patents registered in 12 countries.
- Expansion: live seats, baggage, meals, priority baggage, golf packs; upcoming Block Seat, SIM/eSIM, home-airport pickup, airport duty-free, airport facility services. Global airline ancillary revenue was about USD 109.5B in 2019 (IdeaWorks).
- Hub: [Business model hub (ko/en/ja)](https://allwinair.com/intro/index.html)

## Interactive demos (mobile screens, Korean)
- [AI Seat Recommendation & ancillary demo - Jin Air (LJ)](https://allwinair.com/demo/ass/LJ/index.html): AI recommends seats for the whole party from booking (PNR) context, then the customer continues to in-flight meal pre-order and pre-paid baggage. AI 좌석추천·기내식·사전 수하물 데모
- [Pre-paid baggage demo - Jin Air (LJ)](https://allwinair.com/demo/ass/LJ/service_baggage.html): buy extra checked baggage weight before departure (+5kg to +30kg per passenger), cheaper than paying at the airport. 사전 수하물 데모
- [In-flight meal pre-order demo - Jin Air (LJ)](https://allwinair.com/demo/ass/LJ/service_food.html): pre-order paid in-flight meals that cannot be bought at the airport or on board, with menu suggestions per passenger. 기내식 사전 주문 데모
- [Priority baggage demo - Jin Air (LJ)](https://allwinair.com/demo/ass/LJ/service_baggage_first.html): priority tag so checked bags come out first at the arrival airport. 빠른짐찾기(우선 수하물) 데모
- [Block Seat demo - Jeju Air (7C)](https://allwinair.com/demo/bls/7C/index.html): before departure, buy unsold empty seats next to your own seat to spread out or lie down; party sizes 1-4 can be switched in the demo. 블록좌석(빈 옆좌석 추가 구매) 데모

# Allwin Air (オールウィンエア)
- Service: B2B Airline Ancillary Service Integration API Solution
- Japanese Summary: オールウィンエアは、LCCや旅行会社向けに座席・手荷物・機内食などの航空付帯サービスAPI統合ソリューションを提供しています。
